tasks.title: three hygiene primitives
tasks.objective: Add three deterministic primitives: cmd_mode_abandon in quickfix.py (closes the active window with an abandoned ledger row + reason, bypassing mode done's completion gates; refuses if none open), registered as forge mode abandon; factor intake's stale-file list (intake.py) into stale_task_state(base) that REPORTS stale artifacts (never clears); and a repo-wide secret/cruft scan in a new forge_cli/sanitise.py reusing context.SECRET_PATTERNS over source + an untracked-droppings lister.
acceptance_criteria: forge mode abandon closes the active window recording an abandoned ledger row + reason without mode done's commit/review gates; refuses if no window is open.
stale_task_state(base) reports the stale task-scoped .factory artifacts (reusing intake's list) and does NOT clear them.
The repo-wide secret/cruft scan flags source secrets (context.SECRET_PATTERNS) and untracked droppings (.DS_Store/.factory junk); it reports, never auto-removes.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "mode_abandon or stale_task_state or secret_cruft"
tasks.reviewer_focus: mode abandon is ledgered + refuses when none open; stale_task_state REPORTS not clears (evidence safety); the scan reports, never auto-removes secrets; intake behaviour unchanged by the factoring.

tasks.title: forge sanitise command
tasks.objective: Add cmd_sanitise in sanitise.py (registered in forge.py): compose project.project_gaps + the secret/cruft scan + stale_task_state + open-window detection + doctor's read-only checks into one report; apply ONLY safe fixes (roadmap heal when drift exists; git rm --cached tracked cruft via check_repo_budget's globs); --check skips all fixes (read-only); exit 1 iff any issue; plain sanitise exits 1 iff any UNRESOLVED issue remains. Never auto-deletes evidence or fabricates.
acceptance_criteria: forge sanitise heals roadmap drift and git rm --cached's tracked cruft, and REPORTS board gaps, secrets, stale task-state, open windows, and untracked cruft; it never auto-deletes evidence or fabricates.
forge sanitise --check fixes nothing (read-only) and exits nonzero iff any issue exists; plain sanitise exits nonzero iff any UNRESOLVED issue remains.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "sanitise"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Only heal + tracked-cruft-rm are auto-fixed; stale state + open windows + secrets are REPORTED not touched; --check writes nothing (CI-safe); exit-code semantics correct; no fabrication.

tasks.title: skill + update-triggered cadence + docs
tasks.objective: Add install/claude/knacklabs-sanitise-project/SKILL.md (on-demand runbook wrapping forge sanitise / --check, naming the resolve commands for reported items), registered in setup's bootstrap loop. Remove harness-health.yml's daily schedule cron and trigger it on workflow_dispatch + push:branches:[main]. Add doc rows in README.md + factory/skills/forge.md. Add a structure/registration test + a test asserting harness-health has no schedule cron.
acceptance_criteria: A knacklabs-sanitise-project skill wraps forge sanitise (on demand) and is in setup's bootstrap loop (installs to both runtimes).
harness-health.yml has NO schedule cron; it triggers on workflow_dispatch + push:branches:[main] and still short-circuits cheaply when the client is up-to-date.
board-invariant.yml still enforces completeness on push:main (the cadence change does not drop that gate).
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "sanitise_skill or harness_health"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Skill is on-demand (not scheduled) + registered; harness-health has no schedule cron but keeps workflow_dispatch + push:main + the version-compare short-circuit; board-invariant unchanged.
